work_packages.title: Establish repository, toolchains and verification harness
work_packages.deliverables: toolchain/dependency policy, minimal Rust workspace and managed test client, documented PowerShell entry points, CI jobs, dependency-direction checks and coverage/mutation tool evaluation. Choose a source license before distributing implementation dependencies; retain component/transitive license records. Repo/docs creation in this planning baseline does not complete the implementation package.
work_packages.verification: Build clean CPU-only examples, execute meaningful smoke/failure tests, parse all StrictDoc files and publish real coverage scopes/tool versions. Check Windows x86-64 and Linux x86-64 first; explicitly review macOS arm64 support before the M1 release profile is frozen.
work_packages.estimate: Small to Medium; revisit after toolchain/native packaging inspection.

work_packages.title: Freeze equation, unit and model-state conventions
work_packages.deliverables: lower-level StrictDoc equations/contracts, R/C/L/source and diode reference fixtures, derivative checks, known singular cases, initial-condition semantics and fixture-specific error bounds.
work_packages.verification: Compare assembled equations, Jacobians and charge derivatives to analytic/independent references; detect deliberate sign and derivative mutations. Record why solver tolerances do not imply global waveform accuracy.
work_packages.estimate: Medium; limit initial devices to those needed for the first analog slice.

work_packages.title: Evaluate CPU providers and Rust/C++ integration
work_packages.deliverables: sparse real/complex matrix corpus; CPU direct-provider spikes, preferably KLU plus an independently implemented candidate; license/build/index/precision review; measured coarse-call adapter cost; Rust versus C++ decision record. Do not count two wrappers of the same factorization as independent providers.
work_packages.verification: Check residuals, transpose/complex behavior, nonsymmetric/indefinite/singular cases and repeated-value/structural invalidation. Publish clean-build and end-to-end measurements; select rather than assume native-library compatibility.
work_packages.estimate: Medium, time-box unsuccessful provider builds and record rejection reasons.

work_packages.title: Prove Rust-to-.NET result and lifecycle contracts
work_packages.deliverables: versioned schema sketches/golden fixtures, minimal C ABI/worker round trip, SafeHandle disposal tests, bounded event queue and Arrow .NET batch reading experiment. This spike may use a deterministic fixture operation; label it as a fixture rather than a simulator.
work_packages.verification: Test malformed lengths, unknown versions, stale handles, slow readers, client disposal, native exceptions/panics and worker crash classification. Run C# file-based and F# Interactive examples without Python.
work_packages.estimate: Medium.

work_packages.title: Validate external nonlinear/DAE integration fit
work_packages.deliverables: SUNDIALS or PETSc adapter experiment, documented residual/Jacobian mapping, one nonlinear-charge fixture, algebraic constraint and explicit-time cases, integration-versus-reimplementation decision. Deferred adoption does not imply rejection of the role interface.
work_packages.verification: Independently differentiate the actual continuous-residual callback and compare transient/event/initialization results. Confirm exactly one Newton and one timestep controller own their respective histories.
work_packages.estimate: Research; initially 1-2 engineer-weeks, then adopt, defer or narrow scope.

work_packages.title: Evaluate compiled-model, GPU and DSL boundaries
work_packages.accountable_role: model engineer, numerical lead and interoperability engineer
work_packages.deliverables: pinned OSDI descriptor/evaluation mapping for one model; a real GPU solve experiment if supported hardware exists; Starlark/F# authoring comparison yielding the same canonical plan. Record separate adopt/defer/reject decisions. C#/F# remains the trusted automation path.
work_packages.verification: Check model charge/derivatives and rollback semantics; include transfers in GPU measurements; test DSL import/expansion limits, units and source mapping. A missing GPU is an explicit unexecuted experiment, not a simulated hardware pass.
work_packages.estimate: Research; separate short time boxes totaling initially 2-3 engineer-weeks; can continue after the CPU slice begins if no core-contract risk remains.

work_packages.title: Implement immutable circuit and plan compilation
work_packages.deliverables: minimal sim-types/IR/compiler modules, quantity validation, topology diagnostics, signal catalog, model bindings, source spans and structural/numeric identity rules. Start with structured input rather than broad netlist compatibility.
work_packages.verification: Test invalid references/units, floating islands, ideal constraints, stamp bounds, equivalent node/hierarchy transformations and structural-parameter invalidation using seeded property tests and fuzz fixtures.
work_packages.estimate: Medium to Large.

work_packages.title: Productionize the first CPU backend
work_packages.deliverables: backend factory/capabilities, direct-linear session, pattern/value invalidation, real/complex support needed for M1, native lifecycle tests and CPU-only packaging.
work_packages.verification: Pass the shared matrix corpus and fault/lifetime tests, compare residuals to independent references and report wrapper/native coverage separately. Never report a vendor success code as circuit convergence.
work_packages.estimate: Medium to Large, depending on native packaging.

work_packages.title: Implement baseline device evaluation and assembly
work_packages.deliverables: model descriptors, validated parameters/domains, local/global bindings, state layout and observables. Qualify R/source DC first, then C/L dynamic contributions and diode behavior; additional transistor profiles require separate reviewed equations and corpus scope.
work_packages.verification: Compare device values/derivatives independently, test sign/polarity and malformed model descriptors, and retain mutation tests that kill incorrect stamp/charge contributions.
work_packages.estimate: Large; sequence device subsets rather than wait for the complete list.

work_packages.title: Deliver operating point and bounded nonlinear solve
work_packages.deliverables: DC driver, qualified Newton implementation or adopted controller, source/gmin recovery policy, explicit initial guesses and regularization records. Declare controller choice using M0 evidence; PLAN-005 is required only if that external controller is selected.
work_packages.verification: Check analytic linear/diode circuits, tiny-update/large-residual rejection, overflow, singularity, hard starts and multiple solutions without uniqueness claims.
work_packages.estimate: Large.

work_packages.title: Implement bounded worker jobs and typed results
work_packages.deliverables: job/attempt IDs, CPU thread/resource budgets, local IPC version/frame policy, C ABI ownership and managed disposal/cancellation, minimal manifest and measurement descriptors. Native model sandbox claims are deferred until PLAN-019 passes.
work_packages.verification: Run a C#/F# resistor/diode case; test invalid/singular inputs, terminal-state races, late cancellation, blocked consumers, worker crashes and stale handles. Publish API conformance and coverage evidence.
work_packages.estimate: Large.

work_packages.title: Implement AC from operating-point linearization
work_packages.deliverables: frequency grids, complex source/excitation rules, G+j*omega*C assembly, axis/signal descriptors and phase/reference conventions.
work_packages.verification: Compare analytic RC/RLC/controlled-source transfer functions and complex values, reject unsupported model capabilities and verify source polarity and frequency units.
work_packages.estimate: Medium to Large.

work_packages.title: Implement transient integration and transactional state
work_packages.deliverables: start with backward Euler, then qualified trapezoidal/BDF scope; predictors, history buffers, local error/scaling, source breakpoints, model events and requested output-grid semantics. External integrator adoption additionally requires PLAN-005 evidence.
work_packages.verification: Check analytic RC/RLC, charged initial states, stiff/switching cases, event-edge timing and forced rejection with identical accepted-state replay. Retain state-commit and error-control mutation checks.
work_packages.estimate: Large; high numerical risk and likely multiple qualification iterations.

work_packages.title: Deliver streaming, measurement and durable evidence
work_packages.deliverables: Arrow stream/file distinction, batch envelopes, signal/axis/complex schemas, measurement windows/interpolation, assertion indeterminate policy, staged artifacts, hashes and a managed reader. Add Parquet only when campaign workflows justify it.
work_packages.verification: Test independent Arrow readers, throttling/memory bounds, missing/duplicate batches, disk-full, corrupted artifacts, incomplete windows and atomic manifest publication. Run the RC transient through C# and F# end to end.
work_packages.estimate: Large.

work_packages.title: Add a scoped SPICE compatibility frontend
work_packages.deliverables: lexer/parser, include policy, hierarchical parameters, suffix rules, construct support table and minimal interoperability corpus. Broad LTspice/PSpice control-language parity remains outside M1.
work_packages.verification: Fuzz lexical/expression/include boundaries, test M versus MEG and expansion errors, compare equivalent text/JSON plans and report parse/elaborate/solve compatibility separately.
work_packages.estimate: Large, scope constrained by a reviewed construct whitelist.

work_packages.title: Qualify a second independent provider and selection policy
work_packages.deliverables: second adapter, shared conformance results, roles/options schema, session/cache validation and backend selection/reporting. An iterative provider is not presented as a drop-in direct solver without convergence evidence.
work_packages.verification: Compare circuit/matrix residuals and outcomes, test unsupported scalar/index/placement combinations, misspelled options and changed-build cache invalidation. Distinguish changed convergence paths from semantic incompatibility.
work_packages.estimate: Medium to Large.

work_packages.title: Maintain continuous numerical and adversarial qualification
work_packages.deliverables: ongoing matrix/device/circuit/API suites, bounded PR fuzz/property runs, documented longer manually or CI-triggered campaigns, minimized replay fixtures, coverage scopes/exclusions and reviewed project thresholds. This package begins early and does not defer testing until release.
work_packages.verification: Demonstrate detection of stamp-sign, derivative, stale-factor, missing-rollback and false-complete-result mutations; adjudicate independent-oracle disagreements rather than auto-update golden values. Separate GPU/native coverage from host wrapper coverage.
work_packages.estimate: Ongoing; reserve explicit capacity in every code work package.

work_packages.title: Publish the first qualified CPU release profile
work_packages.deliverables: frozen M1 profile, license/notices/SBOM, pinned package builds, Rust/C#/F# examples, capability query, baseline performance/memory report and requirement-evidence inventory. Native plugin/GPU/DSL features may remain experimental or absent.
work_packages.verification: Install on every claimed platform without developer native-library paths; run offline CPU/API/failure smoke tests, full approved qualification and previous-supported-schema tests if applicable. Block known correctness-critical defects and unsupported evidence claims.
work_packages.estimate: Medium to Large after component gates pass; release repair time is not assumed zero.

work_packages.title: Qualify compiled-model packages and native isolation
work_packages.deliverables: ABI mapping specification, package hashes/licenses, model-domain corpus, library lifetime/serialization policy and per-platform sandbox support matrix. A subprocess alone is not a security sandbox.
work_packages.verification: Compare IV/charge/derivatives/transient/noise where claimed, force rejected steps, load mismatched descriptors and crash/hang/access-forbidden-path fixture plugins. Refuse untrusted mode when configured OS restrictions cannot be enforced.
work_packages.estimate: Large plus model-family-specific qualification.

work_packages.title: Qualify optional GPU linear and batched execution
work_packages.deliverables: one cuDSS or Ginkgo GPU adapter first, real hardware capability/build matrix, transfer-inclusive cold/warm benchmarks, host/device budgets, attempt/checkpoint policy and no-GPU package tests. CPU OSDI code remains CPU code unless independently GPU-compiled and qualified.
work_packages.verification: Compare residuals/waveforms to CPU within approved bounds, measure memory and transfer costs, inject device/OOM/cancellation faults and verify attempts/sample offsets. Do not impose a common adaptive timestep on unrelated cases merely to batch them.
work_packages.estimate: Large after hardware and package feasibility are demonstrated; GPU model kernels are a separate later proposal.

work_packages.title: Implement the selected definition DSL and behavioral IR
work_packages.deliverables: pinned Starlark or alternative decision, versioned host modules, unit-aware constructors, authorized imports, budgets/source diagnostics, expression IR/domain/derivative policy and equivalent C#/F# authoring examples.
work_packages.verification: Compare RC/subcircuit/sweep/assertion plans across frontends, fuzz imports and expansion limits and independently test nonlinear behavioral derivatives. Prove no definition-interpreter callback occurs in the Newton/device hot loop.
work_packages.estimate: Large; stabilize a narrow domain library before inventing new grammar or an editor.

work_packages.title: Deliver reproducible campaigns and StressForge mapping
work_packages.deliverables: campaign plan/manifest, C#/F# driver, typed assertion/evidence outcomes, statistical policy for supported distributions and pinned actual StressForge mapping when accessible. Campaign restart is distinct from arbitrary mid-transient resume.
work_packages.verification: Compare serial/parallel/reordered assignments, kill/restart the campaign, corrupt an artifact and inspect attempt accounting and pass/fail/indeterminate/infrastructure_error distinctions. Test against the actual external project's pinned integration suite before any compatibility claim.
work_packages.estimate: Large; external project scope remains uncertain until its API is reviewed.

work_packages.title: Expand analyses and model families by demand
work_packages.deliverables: prioritized family/analysis subplans, noise correlation/unit contracts and model-domain/license records. Periodic/RF/distributed work remains a separately approved M3 scope.
work_packages.verification: Run analysis-specific independent references, derivative/noise/energy checks and API schemas; publish unsupported cases and model-versus-numerical accuracy limits.
work_packages.estimate: Research to Large per analysis/model family; no bundled completion date.
